body:
Track 10 follow-up to `swe-schedule`: reads the pick mix and run concurrency off git history instead of assuming them.

- Whole-period mix is far from uniform, but mostly because tracks 7-11 were added late; after all eleven existed (36 PRs) uniform is not rejected (p=0.25, low power).
- Same-track excess among overlapping PRs (17.9% vs 12.3%) disappears when shuffling within merge day (p=0.115).
- Preliminary: merged projects stand in for picks; branch overlap is a lower bound.

Verified: `python3 -m unittest discover -s research/swe-pickmix/tests` (10 pass); `python3 site/build.py` -> `ok: 463 projects, 4059 tests`.
